Name: Four vegan bears for Stardew valley 1.5
Author: Oklinq
Description:
[size=1]Before 29.12.2020 this mod was know as Vegan truffle Bears for Stardew valley 1.5
This mod is inspired by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2695]Friendly magical vegan truffle bears (pig replacement)[/url][size=1]﻿ by DorakoKentaurosu/Ms_Paintdra.[/size]
[size=1]This mod is working with Stardew valley 1.5, the original mod only with 1.3[/size]

[color=#ff0000][size=3][b]NOTE! you have to delete the old version before you update because of new mod name![/b][/size][/color]
[size=4]This mod replaces animals (including horse) with cute bears
[/size][size=5]Sheep = Polarbear
Cow = Pandabear
Pig = Brownbear
Horse = Blackbear
[/size]

[size=2]Also you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/F76hRrXKAX]my Discord[/url] for support[/size][color=#f4f4f4][font=Comic Sans MS]


[size=6]How to config:
[/size]1. open the config.json with a texteditor that can read json files
2. search the animal you want to enable/disable 
3. enter true/false in the "" after the animal (true=enabled false=disabled) on default everything ist true
4. save the file and restart your game

[/font][/color]
